description: The acceptance criterion in rcf-schemas gains an optional verification property, enum external | testOnly, in a minor release (0.10.0) with additionalProperties still false, and rcf-lite moves its pin to that release. rcf define create ac carries verification from --from-file, rcf define update <AC id> --set verification=<value> writes it, a value outside the enum exits 3, and rcf define validate over this repository's own chain still exits 0 after the pin moves. The requirement rule (validate requires the flag on new and amended criteria) and coverage end states are the flag slice, not this one.
rationale: Redesign change 2 and status model (redesign :71, :85): the flag must be a field so validate, Review and coverage can read it. At rcf-schemas 906b6682 the criterion object is closed with no verification property (read at 0.9.0 in node_modules), so the field needs a schema release first; the REQ-194 precedent is the consumer side of an rcf-schemas release riding one record's Build.
title: rcf-schemas carries the AC verification flag (external or testOnly) and rcf-lite consumes it
